case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's location with sea views and beach access, the friendly, professional staff, cleanliness, and strong breakfasts with great views. Several reviews noted restaurant and reservation frustrations (a closed restaurant, inability to reserve), occasional noise/soundproofing issues and room-darkness/door-closing concerns, plus isolated Wi-Fi, TV channel, and price-value comments; some guests appreciated complimentary minibar and celebratory touches.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.area: Food & Beverage operations — restaurant availability and reservation policy
priorities.recommendation: Enforce clear policy ensuring F&B hours communicated, priority bookings, staff training, and closure logs/notifications.

priorities.area: Room soundproofing & door function (guest comfort and safety)
priorities.recommendation: Inspect/log/repair doors immediately; schedule acoustic assessment, implement mitigation, prevent selling affected rooms or warn/relocate guests.

priorities.area: In‑room environment — lighting and visibility of view/terrace
priorities.recommendation: Walk rooms to evaluate lighting, add/adjust bedside lamps, ensure housekeeping presents windows unobstructed, assess finishes/layout.

priorities.area: Room door security & soundproofing (room comfort / access)
priorities.recommendation: Immediately inspect door-closing mechanisms and room-lobby noise pathways; repair defects, document scope, review front-desk escalation/room-change.
Conduct audit: assess Wi‑Fi, logs, and TV lineup; plan remediation or vendor engagement; update messaging.

priorities.area: Restaurant availability & guest communication (restaurant and bar)
priorities.recommendation: Review and clarify guest reservation policy, verify communication protocols, and ensure staff have updated information.
